**Credit name:** Francisco Couzo ([franciscouzo/square-packing](https://github.com/franciscouzo/square-packing)). Original construction, seed and certificate credits are retained in the linked manifest.

Follow-up to [#675](https://github.com/jlevy/squares/issues/675).

Please register the **85 improved upper bounds** below. Each is strictly smaller than the [previous published repository bound](https://github.com/franciscouzo/square-packing/blob/c6da0fc7524d667bf3d224559724ba9b60762e60/upper_bounds.json) and the reviewed public comparison envelope, including pending submissions, deletion and repeated L borders. Only improved counts below 1024 are listed.

**Source commit:** [`7b6c87e129cf80b5ff9847b90b47fd30b4563c54`](https://github.com/franciscouzo/square-packing/commit/7b6c87e129cf80b5ff9847b90b47fd30b4563c54).

The comparisons include all Göbel squares, ordinary and corner strips, Friedman off-centre constructions, square tilings, repeated L borders and deletion. None matches or beats a bound in this table.

**Certificates:** values are rounded **upward** to 12 decimal places; the exact rational side in each certificate header is authoritative. If the linked witness contains more squares than the target count, delete the surplus squares. The [complete index](https://github.com/franciscouzo/square-packing/blob/7b6c87e129cf80b5ff9847b90b47fd30b4563c54/upper_bounds.json) records each relationship; the [manifest](https://github.com/franciscouzo/square-packing/blob/7b6c87e129cf80b5ff9847b90b47fd30b4563c54/certificates/best/manifest.json) records source credits, parent hashes and verification receipts.

**Construction credits:** earlier seed/construction lineages remain attached to the witnesses, including Joost de Winter’s Young-corner/slipped-ribbon and four-block families, Kevin Fang’s rectangle/gluing constructions, and the credited square inputs and prior refinements. The local Young-corner/slipped-ribbon reconstruction is recorded separately from de Winter’s published witnesses.

**Verification:** new or changed source witnesses passed exact rational replay using the jlevy/squares corner verifier and this repository’s centre/projection verifier. Earlier receipts are reused only for identical certificate bytes. Both implementations use exact half-angle rotations and separating-axis geometry. The contract is containment in a closed square with disjoint square interiors; boundary contact is allowed.

Replay from the pinned checkout with Python 3 and its standard library:

```sh
python3 verify_bound_certificate.py certificates/best/*.cert
```
